rules.title: Secret exposed through a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable
rules.why: NEXT_PUBLIC_ values are inlined into client JavaScript, so anything secret in one is public.
rules.fix: Rename it without the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix and read it only on the server.

rules.title: SVG optimization enabled for untrusted images
rules.why: dangerouslyAllowSVG lets crafted SVG files run script when opened directly.
rules.fix: Keep it off, or set a strict contentSecurityPolicy for images.
